verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story. A dedicated API versioning page commits that each Messages API version preserves its existing input and output parameters. Pinned, dated model IDs are documented separately from the moving dateless forms. A standing model-deprecations page sets per-model retirement floors (e.g. 'Not sooner than September 1, 2027') with advance notice and migration guides. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation timelines are honored in practice, and explicit evidence of a retirement policy for API versions themselves as distinct from model retirement.
